# Lucy

## Overview

- **Age:** 17 years old  <sub>[v3 c3 P1](../source/v03-c03.md#nw-v03-c03-p0001), [v4 c36 P4](../source/v04-c36.md#nw-v04-c36-p0004)</sub>
- **Gender:** female  <sub>[v2 c1 P33](../source/v02-c01.md#nw-v02-c01-p0033), [v2 c8 P44](../source/v02-c08.md#nw-v02-c08-p0044)</sub>
- **Status:** alive  <sub>[v4 c4 P3](../source/v04-c04.md#nw-v04-c04-p0003), [v4 c36 P4](../source/v04-c36.md#nw-v04-c36-p0004)</sub>

## Appearance

Lucy is a fair-haired girl with long, sleek curls that are kept perfectly neat. She has gentle, mild hazel eyes, a straight nose, plump fingers, and a mouth that often sets in a decorous, precise expression. She presents an immaculate appearance, often wearing clean, starched dresses with accents such as a black sash.

_Sources: [v2 c8 P25](../source/v02-c08.md#nw-v02-c08-p0025), [v2 c8 P44](../source/v02-c08.md#nw-v02-c08-p0044), [v2 c16 P12](../source/v02-c16.md#nw-v02-c16-p0012)_

## Personality

Lucy is remarkably calm, well-behaved, and unvarying in her temperament. Extremely rigid, proper, and decorous, she is rarely unsettled by frights or emotional disruptions. She is systematic, tidy, dependable, and cautious, approaching her chores and responsibilities with submissive diligence and quiet care.

_Sources: [v2 c7 P30](../source/v02-c07.md#nw-v02-c07-p0030), [v2 c8 P44](../source/v02-c08.md#nw-v02-c08-p0044), [v2 c10 P85](../source/v02-c10.md#nw-v02-c10-p0085), [v2 c14 P30](../source/v02-c14.md#nw-v02-c14-p0030), [v2 c16 P12](../source/v02-c16.md#nw-v02-c16-p0012), [v2 c24 P10](../source/v02-c24.md#nw-v02-c24-p0010), [v2 c24 P25](../source/v02-c24.md#nw-v02-c24-p0025), [v2 c26 P33](../source/v02-c26.md#nw-v02-c26-p0033), [v3 c3 P1](../source/v03-c03.md#nw-v03-c03-p0001), [v4 c4 P5](../source/v04-c04.md#nw-v04-c04-p0005)_

## History

Lucy was born as a twin alongside her brother Robin Farrow. Following the death of their father shortly after their birth and the eventual passing of their mother, Lucy and Robin were taken in by Thirza Abernethy to live at Grey Shutters. Lucy adapted easily to her new household, assisting with small tasks such as feeding chickens, gathering chips, and drying dishes. While her twin brother frequently caused mischief, Lucy remained neat, calm, and obedient, sitting quietly during community gatherings and executing her chores systematically. During a severe hail storm that frightened the household, Lucy remained composed and silent. Following the death of Richard Farrow, a trust of two thousand dollars was left for Lucy and her brother until they reached adulthood or marriage, securing Grey Shutters as their permanent home. Over the years, she continued to be a dependable, cautious, and helpful presence at Grey Shutters, assisting with guests and young children.

_Sources: [v2 c1 P33](../source/v02-c01.md#nw-v02-c01-p0033), [v2 c8 P1](../source/v02-c08.md#nw-v02-c08-p0001), [v2 c8 P44](../source/v02-c08.md#nw-v02-c08-p0044), [v2 c16 P12](../source/v02-c16.md#nw-v02-c16-p0012), [v2 c22 P22](../source/v02-c22.md#nw-v02-c22-p0022), [v2 c22 P25](../source/v02-c22.md#nw-v02-c22-p0025), [v2 c24 P10](../source/v02-c24.md#nw-v02-c24-p0010), [v2 c24 P25](../source/v02-c24.md#nw-v02-c24-p0025), [v4 c4 P3](../source/v04-c04.md#nw-v04-c04-p0003), [v4 c4 P5](../source/v04-c04.md#nw-v04-c04-p0005), [v4 c4 P7](../source/v04-c04.md#nw-v04-c04-p0007)_
